verses.text: Mamin Jehová, t'a smasanil in k'ool ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh juntzanh Dios.

Ol in em kuman t'ayach t'a stojolal a templo to iknhej yaji, yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ayach yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tzak'elk'och tas tzala'. Ix ik'chaanh a b'i yet' a lolonel t'a yib'anh masanil tastak.
Ix ach tak'wi t'ayin ayik ix in awaj t'ayach, ix ak'an wip.
Masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach ayik ol yab'an heb' tas alnakkani.
Ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj tastak a b'onak, yujto te niwan yelk'och a b'inajnakil.
Wach'chom te niwan elk'ochi, palta tz'ok' a k'ol t'a heb' anima emnakil yek'i, haxo heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, max ach b'atlaj k'elan t'a heb'.
Ayik ay in ek' t'a skal tas ay smay, pitzan innhej uuj, tzak'ankot a poder, tzin a kolanel t'a yowal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ach Jehová, ol ach och wet'ok yik wach'nhej tzin elk'och t'a tas tza na t'ayin. Ha a wach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Ha tastak ix ik'el yich t'ayin, mokab' kan xepan.
